title: बालविकासमा सहजकर्ता र व्यवस्थापकको भूमिका
nepali: यो अध्ययन प्रारम्भिक बालविकास सहजकर्ताले बालविकासमा खेलेको भूमिका र केन्द्रको व्यवस्थापकीय पक्षले बालविकासमा पारेको प्रभावमा केन्द्रित रहेर गरिएको छ । अध्ययनको लागि बागलुङ जिल्ला गल्कोट नगरपालिका वार्ड नं. आठका चारवटा प्रारम्भिक बालविकास केन्द्रलाई आधार बनाइएको छ । सुविधाजनक विधिको प्रयोग गरी त्यहाँका भौतिक अवस्था, सहजकर्ता, मातृ विद्यालयका प्र.अ., व्यवस्थापन समितिका अध्यक्ष, विद्यार्थीका अभिभावकलाई नमूनाको रूपमा छनौट गरी सूचना सङ्ककलनमा अभिभावकसँग समूह छलफल, प्र.अ. र सहजकर्ताका लागि प्रश्नावली, अवलोकन फारम र अन्तरवार्ताबाट प्राप्त तथ्यलाई विकसित सिद्धान्तको उपयोग गरी विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । सम्पूर्ण व्यवस्थापकीय पक्ष तथा सहजकर्ताका व्यवहारलाई सीमा निर्धारण गरी मिश्रित अनुसन्धान विधिको प्रयोग गरी यो अध्ययन गरिएको छ । यसबाट सहजकर्ताले उपलब्ध सीमित स्रोत र साधनका बाबजुद पनि कर्तव्यनिष्ठ भएर बालकको सर्वाङ्गीण विकासमा सकरात्मक भूमिका निर्वाह गरेको र व्यवस्थापकीय पक्षले पनि उपलब्ध भएका स्रोतसाधनलाई उचित व्यवस्थापनद्वारा बालमैत्रीपूर्ण व्यवस्थापन गरेर बालविकासमा सहयोग पु¥याए तापनि सहजकर्ता सन्तुष्ट नभएको कारण कार्यान्वयनमा देखिएका समस्यालाई निवारण गर्न विविध स्रोतबाट आर्थिक स्रोत जुटाएर सन्तुष्ट हुने वातावरणको सिर्जना गर्न सकिने कुरालाई यस अध्ययनबाट देखाउन खोजिएको छ ।
american_english: This study was conducted focusing on the role played by early childhood development facilitators in child development and the effect of the center's managerial aspect on child development. For the study, four early childhood development centers in Ward No. 8 of Galkot Municipality, Baglung district, were taken as the basis. Using a convenient method, the physical conditions there, facilitators, principals of mother schools, chairpersons of management committees and students' parents were selected as samples, and facts obtained through group discussion with parents, questionnaires for principals and facilitators, observation forms and interviews were analyzed using developed theory. By setting boundaries on all managerial aspects and facilitators' behavior, this study was conducted using a mixed research method. From this, it has been shown that facilitators carried out a positive role in the all-round development of children with a sense of duty despite limited available resources and means, and that the managerial aspect also contributed to child development by managing the available resources and means in a child-friendly manner; however, because facilitators were not satisfied, the problems seen in implementation could be resolved by mobilizing financial resources from various sources to create an environment of satisfaction.

informal_english: Ja, this study looked at what role early childhood development facilitators play in kids' development, plus how the centre's management side affects child development. They used four ECD centres in Ward 8 of Galkot Municipality, Baglung district. Using a convenience approach, they sampled the physical conditions, the facilitators, principals of mother schools, management committee chairs and parents, then analysed the info from parent group discussions, questionnaires for principals and facilitators, observation forms and interviews using developed theory. They bounded all the managerial aspects and facilitator behaviour and used a mixed research method. What came out is that facilitators did a solid job in kids' all-round development despite limited resources, and management also helped by running things in a child-friendly way, but facilitators weren't satisfied, so the implementation hiccups could be sorted by pulling together financial resources from various sources to create a satisfying environment.
